name: Pallets (Flask, Jinja, Click)
description: The organization behind Flask, Jinja, Click, Werkzeug and other Python web libraries.
summary: New contributors may not use LLM or AI tools at all, and contributions that look AI-generated are closed with the author likely blocked. Trusted contributors' work must still be understood and created personally. The policy covers all interactions, and AI may not be used to translate or improve what you write.

evidence.quote: If you are a new contributor, do not use LLM or AI tools to contribute at all; you do not have the trust or experience to take responsibility for what is generated.
your contribution must still genuinely be understood and created personally by you, regardless of what tools you may use to assist you.
If your contribution appears generated by LLM or AI tools, or you attempt to obfuscate that, it will be closed and you are likely to be blocked.
This policy applies to all interactions with our projects and community, not only code and pull requests.
Do not use LLM tools to translate or "improve" what you say and do.
This includes code, documentation, tests, PR descriptions, comments, reviews, answers, and all other interactions.
